headline: Infibeam Avenues stock price and chart live on Upstox
hook: Live tracking page for listed fintech stock
summary: This is a live price tracking page for Infibeam Avenues, which trades on the NSE under the ticker CCAVENUE. The page provides real-time stock quotes and performance charts for investors monitoring the company's shares. Retail investors use such platforms to track intraday price movements and technical charts.
why_it_matters: Real-time stock data reference for Infibeam Avenues investors

headline: AvenuesAI initiates forfeiture process for partly paid-up equity shares due to unpaid call money
hook: Unpaid call money sparks share forfeiture notice
summary: AvenuesAI Limited has issued a notice for the forfeiture of partly paid-up equity shares because shareholders failed to pay the first and final call money. This procedural action affects holders who missed the call payment deadline. For Indian retail investors holding the scrip, non-payment and subsequent forfeiture highlights equity dilution risks and compliance steps in capital calls.
why_it_matters: Unpaid call money leads to share forfeiture for defaulting holders.

headline: AvenuesAI halts trading for share consolidation
hook: Trading suspended for AvenuesAI share consolidation
summary: AvenuesAI, formerly Infibeam Avenues, suspended trading effective Tuesday, October 13, 2026. The suspension is part of a corporate action involving the consolidation of its shares. Shareholders may temporarily see their holdings disappear from demat accounts during this process. Trading will resume once the consolidation procedure is completed.
whats_next: Resumption of trading following share consolidation completion
why_it_matters: Temporary disappearance of shares from your demat is expected.

headline: AvenuesAI shares suspended for 1:10 stock consolidation
hook: Trading halt for 7.21 lakh AvenuesAI investors
summary: AvenuesAI will suspend trading of its shares starting October 13 to facilitate a 1:10 share consolidation. This corporate action will affect 7.21 lakh shareholders. The process involves reducing the total number of shares while proportionally increasing the price per share. Investors should note that trading will remain paused until the consolidation process is completed.
why_it_matters: Your holdings will be consolidated, temporarily freezing your ability to trade.

headline: Ola Electric and AvenuesAI approach rights issue and reverse split record dates
hook: Corporate action deadlines hit this week
summary: Ola Electric and AvenuesAI shares are in focus as October 12 marks the final day to buy the stocks to qualify for upcoming corporate actions. Both companies have established October 13 as the official record date for these events. Shareholders must hold the stock by the cut-off date to be eligible for the rights issue and reverse stock split. Retail investors holding or trading these names must factor in the adjusted share values post-record date.
whats_next: October 13 record date for corporate actions
why_it_matters: Eligibility for corporate actions depends on holding shares before record date.

headline: Paytm, Mobikwik, and other fintech stocks drop up to 10%
hook: Fintech stocks face sharp market sell-off
summary: Shares of major Indian fintech players including Paytm, One Mobikwik, Pine Labs, and AvenuesAI fell by as much as 10% in today's trading session. The decline follows a broader trend of volatility impacting the digital payments and financial technology sector. Investors are reacting to shifting market sentiment regarding the profitability and regulatory environment for these platforms. This sell-off impacts retail portfolios heavily invested in the new-age tech space.
why_it_matters: Portfolio value in new-age fintech stocks sees immediate erosion.
winners_losers: Short sellers gain / Fintech shareholders hurt

headline: AvenuesAI sets October 13 as record date for 10:1 stock split
hook: Share count to shrink tenfold at AvenuesAI
summary: AvenuesAI has officially scheduled October 13 as the record date for its 10:1 share consolidation. This corporate action will reduce the total number of outstanding shares by a factor of ten while proportionally increasing the face value of each share. The move is a procedural adjustment to the company's capital structure. Existing shareholders will see their holdings adjusted accordingly on the record date.
whats_next: October 13, 2024: Record date for share consolidation
why_it_matters: Your total investment value remains unchanged despite the share count reduction.
